           EPIPHEGUS VIRGINIANA

         Beechdrop

        (EPIPHEGUS - OROBANCHE)


A remedy for sick, neurasthenic, and nervous headaches, especially in
        women, brought on or made worse by exertion, shopping, etc. Tongue coated yellow; bitter
        taste. Drowsy after meals. Loose stools.   Subinvolution  ,
        with painful menstruation and congestion.



Head.--  Pressing pain in temples   from
        without inwards  ,   worse, left side  .   Viscid salivation  , constant inclination to spit. Sick headache
        coming on when deviating from ordinary pursuits. Headaches from nerve tire caused by mental
        or physical exhaustion,   preceded by hunger  .



Modalities.--    Worse  , from
        working in open air.   Better  , from sleep.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Iris,
        Melilot; Sanguinar. Fagus-Beech-nuts  --(headache and salivation; swelling on
        mouth; dread of water).



Dose.--  First to thirtieth potency.
